lines.text: Many learners say: In my town it has a big park.
Better: In my town there is a big park.
To say something exists, use there is.
There is! In my room there is a bed.

data.wrong: In my town it has a big park.
data.right: In my town there is a big park.
data.why: To say something exists, use there is.
